name: Settlement Time Request
definition: Provides information on the requested settlement time(s) of the payment instruction.

CLSTime.name: CLS Time
CLSTime.definition: Time by which the amount of money must be credited, with confirmation, to the CLS Bank's account at the central bank.|Usage: Time must be expressed in Central European Time (CET).

TillTime.name: Till Time
TillTime.definition: Time until when the payment may be settled.

FromTime.name: From Time
FromTime.definition: Time as from when the payment may be settled.

RejectTime.name: Reject Time
RejectTime.definition: Time by when the payment must be settled to avoid rejection.

Payment.name: Payment
Payment.definition: Payment for which settlement times are specified.
